```{r accent-familiarity-error-detection-rate-analysis-sanity-checks}
tryCatch({
  # ---
  # 1. Load Data
  # ---
  df_fb <- read_csv("./data/Exp1-DATA - FB.csv")
  df_jb <- read_csv("./data/Exp1-DATA - JB.csv")
  df_quest <- read_csv("./data/preprocessed/main_110425_random_fail_48subj_questionnaire_data.csv")
  

  # ---
  # 2. Combine Experimental Data
  # ---
  df_exp_all <- bind_rows(df_fb, df_jb)

  # ---
  # 3. Mark Participants based on score (< 6/8 OR 4/7)
  # ---
  print("Applying new combined failure criterion (< 6/8 OR 4/7)...")
  
  df_exp_all <- df_exp_all %>%
    mutate(
      
      comments = as.character(comments),
      
     
      attention_score_8 = as.numeric(
        str_extract(comments, "(?<=\\()\\d+(?=\\/8)")
      ),
      
     
      attention_score_7 = as.numeric(
        str_extract(comments, "(?<=\\()\\d+(?=\\/7)")
      )
    )


  failed_participants_8 <- df_exp_all %>%
    filter(attention_score_8 < 6) %>%
    pull(participant_id) %>%
    unique()
    
  failed_participants_7 <- df_exp_all %>%
    filter(attention_score_7 == 4) %>%
    pull(participant_id) %>%
    unique()
  
 
  failed_participants <- union(failed_participants_8, failed_participants_7)

  print(paste("Found", length(failed_participants), "total unique participants who failed."))
  print("Failed participant IDs:")
  print(failed_participants)


  df_exp_all <- df_exp_all %>%
    mutate(attention_check_passed = !participant_id %in% failed_participants)
  
 

  # ---
  # 4. Sanity Check
  # ---
  print("--- Sanity Check (New combined rule): Participants who Passed/Failed ---")
  
  status_counts <- df_exp_all %>%
    distinct(participant_id, attention_check_passed) %>%
    count(attention_check_passed)
  
  print(status_counts)
 

  # ---
  # 5. Join with Questionnaire Data
  # ---
  print("Joining with questionnaire data...")
  
  df_final_joined <- df_exp_all %>%
    left_join(df_quest, by = "participant_id")
})


df_clean <- df_full %>%
  filter(attention_check_passed == TRUE)

print(paste("Analyzing", n_distinct(df_clean$participant_id), "participants who passed attention checks."))
```

```{r accent-familiarity-error-detection-rate-analysis}
# ---

print("Preparing data for Plot 1 (calculating per-participant error)...")

# 1. Create labels *first*
df_analysis_labeled <- df_analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    err_reported_label = case_when(
      err_reported_clean == "nans" ~ "Question has no errors",
      err_reported_clean == "nun"  ~ "Unsure",
      err_reported_clean == "y"    ~ "Question needs correction"
    ),
    condition.x = factor(condition.x, levels = c("correct", "phon_err", "non_phon_err", "both_err"))
  )

# 2. Calculate proportions *per participant*
# We use complete() to ensure all 0s are filled in
participant_props <- df_analysis_labeled %>%
  # Count responses for each participant/condition/response_type
  count(participant_id, condition.x, err_reported_label) %>%
  
  # Explicitly fill in 0s for missing combinations
  complete(participant_id, condition.x, err_reported_label, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  
  # Calculate per-participant proportions
  group_by(participant_id, condition.x) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Trials = sum(n),
    Proportion = n / Total_Trials
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3. Calculate Group Mean, N, and Standard Error
plot_summary_with_error_grouped <- participant_props %>%
  group_by(condition.x, err_reported_label) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean_Proportion = mean(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Calculate the min/max for the error bars
  mutate(
    ymin = Mean_Proportion - SE,
    ymax = Mean_Proportion + SE
  )

print("--- Plot Summary for Grouped Chart (Head) ---")
print(head(plot_summary_with_error_grouped))


# ---
# 5. Create Grouped Bar Chart (Not Stacked)
# ---
print("Generating grouped bar chart with error bars...")

p_grouped_chart <- ggplot(plot_summary_with_error_grouped, 
                           aes(x = condition.x, 
                               y = Mean_Proportion, # Use the new Mean
                               fill = err_reported_label,
                               # Add ymin/ymax
                               ymin = ymin,
                               ymax = ymax
                           )) +
  
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black") +
  
  # --- ADDED ERROR BARS ---
  geom_errorbar(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), # Must match geom_bar's dodge
    width = 0.25, # Width of the error bar "caps"
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # --- END ADDED BARS ---
  
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") + # Kept your 'Pastel1' palette
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Proportion of Responses",
    fill = "Participant Response"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_grouped_chart)
```

```{r accent-familiarity-error-detection-rate-analysis-another-way-to-plot-data}
# ---
# 2. Calculate Stimuli Totals (The Denominators)
# ---
# We need the total number of stimuli for each condition (217, 207, 210)
stimuli_totals <- df_analysis_data %>%
  # Note: We do NOT filter for "y" here
  count(condition.x) %>%
  rename(Total_Stimuli = n)

print("--- Total Stimuli per Condition (Denominators) ---")
print(stimuli_totals)

# ---
# 3. Calculate Detections (The Numerators)
# ---
# Now we filter for "y" responses and define "detection"
detections <- df_analysis_data %>%
  filter(err_reported_clean == "y") %>%
  
  # Create new columns to define a "hit"
  mutate(
    # A "Phonological Error" is detected if they say "p" OR "both"
    Phon_Detected = err_type_response %in% c("p", "both"),
    
    # A "Non-Phonological Error" is detected if they say "np" OR "both"
    NonPhon_Detected = err_type_response %in% c("np", "both")
  ) %>%
  
  # Group by condition and sum the hits
  group_by(condition.x) %>%
  summarise(
    Phon_Detections = sum(Phon_Detected),
    NonPhon_Detections = sum(NonPhon_Detected)
  )

print("--- Errors Detected per Condition (Numerators) ---")
print(detections)

# ---
# 4. Join and Calculate Proportions
# ---
# This joins the numerators and denominators
plot_data_summary <- stimuli_totals %>%
  left_join(detections, by = "condition.x") %>%
  
  # Calculate the proportions from your stats
  mutate(
    `phonological error` = Phon_Detections / Total_Stimuli,
    `nonphonological error` = NonPhon_Detections / Total_Stimuli
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter out the "correct" condition which isn't plotted
  filter(condition.x != "correct") %>%
  
  # Select only the columns we need
  select(Stimulus_Condition = condition.x, `phonological error`, `nonphonological error`) %>%
  
  # Pivot to the "long" format for ggplot
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`phonological error`, `nonphonological error`),
    names_to = "Error_Type_Detected",
    values_to = "Proportion"
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter out the NAs (e.g., non-phon errors for phon_err stimuli)
  filter(!is.na(Proportion))


#### Actual plotting:
p_hit_rate_chart <- ggplot(plot_data_summary, 
                           aes(x = Stimulus_Condition, y = Proportion, fill = Error_Type_Detected)) +
  
  # Use position_dodge() to place bars side-by-side
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  
  # Use a "beautiful" color palette
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("phonological error" = "skyblue", 
                               "nonphonological error" = "salmon")) +
  
  # Format Y axis as percentage
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  
  # Add labels
  labs(
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Proportion of Errors Detected",
    fill = "Error Type Detected"
  ) +
  
  # Apply theme
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

# Print the plot
print(p_hit_rate_chart)


#######ERROR BARS

# ---
# 1. Load and Clean Base Data
# ---
print("Loading and cleaning base data...")
# (Assuming df_analysis_base is already created from previous steps)
# (If not, re-run the loading/cleaning code)


# 2. Prepare Data for Plot 2 (Per-Participant)
# ---
print("Preparing data for Plot 2 (calculating per-participant error)...")

# 1. Calculate Stimuli Totals per participant
stimuli_totals_pp <- df_analysis_data %>%
  group_by(participant_id, condition.x) %>%
  count(name = "Total_Stimuli")

# 2. Calculate Detections per participant
detections_pp <- df_analysis_data %>%
  filter(err_reported_clean == "y") %>%
  mutate(
    Phon_Detected = err_type_response %in% c("p", "both"),
    NonPhon_Detected = err_type_response %in% c("np", "both")
  ) %>%
  group_by(participant_id, condition.x) %>%
  summarise(
    Phon_Detections = sum(Phon_Detected),
    NonPhon_Detections = sum(NonPhon_Detected),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. Join and Calculate Proportions per participant
participant_hit_rates <- stimuli_totals_pp %>%
  left_join(detections_pp, by = c("participant_id", "condition.x")) %>%
  mutate(
    Phon_Detections = ifelse(is.na(Phon_Detections), 0, Phon_Detections),
    NonPhon_Detections = ifelse(is.na(NonPhon_Detections), 0, NonPhon_Detections)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `phonological error` = Phon_Detections / Total_Stimuli,
    `nonphonological error` = NonPhon_Detections / Total_Stimuli
  ) %>%
  filter(condition.x != "correct") %>%
  select(participant_id, Stimulus_Condition = condition.x, `phonological error`, `nonphonological error`) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`phonological error`, `nonphonological error`),
    names_to = "Error_Type_Detected",
    values_to = "Proportion"
  )

# 4. Calculate Group Mean, SE, and **NEW "HITS ONLY" FILTER**
plot_summary_with_error <- participant_hit_rates %>%

  # --- THIS IS THE NEW FILTER ---
  # Filter to only show "hits" and remove "false alarms"
  filter(
    (Stimulus_Condition == "phon_err" & Error_Type_Detected == "phonological error") |
    (Stimulus_Condition == "non_phon_err" & Error_Type_Detected == "nonphonological error") |
    (Stimulus_Condition == "both_err") # Keep both bars for the 'both_err' condition
  ) %>%
  # --- END NEW FILTER ---

  group_by(Stimulus_Condition, Error_Type_Detected) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean_Proportion = mean(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ymin = Mean_Proportion - SE,
    ymax = Mean_Proportion + SE
  ) %>%
  mutate(Stimulus_Condition = factor(Stimulus_Condition, 
                                     levels = c("phon_err", "non_phon_err", "both_err")))

print("--- Plot Summary with Error Bars (HITS ONLY) ---")
print(plot_summary_with_error)

# ---
# 5. Create Plot 2 (Hit Rate) - "Hits Only"
# ---
# The plotting code itself doesn't need to change.
# It will now receive data that has already been filtered.
p_hit_rate_chart <- ggplot(plot_summary_with_error, 
                           aes(x = Stimulus_Condition, 
                               y = Mean_Proportion,
                               fill = Error_Type_Detected,
                               ymin = ymin,
                               ymax = ymax
                           )) +
  
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  
  geom_errorbar(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), 
    width = 0.25,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("phonological error" = "skyblue", 
                               "nonphonological error" = "salmon")) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Proportion of Errors Detected",
    fill = "Error Type Detected"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_hit_rate_chart)
```

```{r accent-familiarity-interacts-with-error-detection-rate-analysis}
# Isolate the familiarity data from the full joined file
df_familiarity <- df_final_joined %>%
  filter(stimuli_presented == "exposure_spanish_accent") %>%
  select(participant_id, response_value.y) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rename(exposure_spanish_accent = response_value.y)

# Define the order for your familiarity levels
familiarity_levels <- c("Never", "Sometimes", "Half the time", "Often", "All the time")

# Join familiarity data with our clean trial data
df_analysis_with_familiarity <- df_analysis_data %>%
  left_join(df_familiarity, by = "participant_id") %>%
  # Convert to an ordered factor (like your example)
  mutate(exposure_spanish_accent = factor(exposure_spanish_accent, 
                                          levels = familiarity_levels)) %>%
  # Remove any participants who didn't answer this question
  filter(!is.na(exposure_spanish_accent))

print(paste("Analyzing data for", n_distinct(df_analysis_with_familiarity$participant_id), "participants with familiarity data."))

# ---
# 3. Plot 1 (Grouped Chart) by Familiarity
# ---
print("Generating Plot 1 (Grouped) by Familiarity...")

# 1. Calculate proportions, grouping by familiarity
prop_data_familiarity <- df_analysis_with_familiarity %>%
  count(exposure_spanish_accent, condition.x, err_reported_clean) %>%
  group_by(exposure_spanish_accent, condition.x) %>%
  mutate(Proportion = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # Create labels
  mutate(
    err_reported_label = case_when(
      err_reported_clean == "nans" ~ "Question has no errors",
      err_reported_clean == "nun"  ~ "Unsure",
      err_reported_clean == "y"    ~ "Question needs correction"
    ),
    condition.x = factor(condition.x, levels = c("correct", "phon_err", "non_phon_err", "both_err"))
  )

# 2. Create the plot with facet_wrap()
p_grouped_chart_familiarity <- ggplot(prop_data_familiarity, 
                       aes(x = condition.x, y = Proportion, fill = err_reported_label)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  
  # --- THIS IS THE NEW LINE ---
  facet_wrap(~ exposure_spanish_accent) +
  # --- END NEW LINE ---
  
  labs(
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Proportion of Responses",
    fill = "Participant Response"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black") # Controls the facet labels
  )

print(p_grouped_chart_familiarity)
ggsave("stimulus_vs_response_GROUPED_by_familiarity.png", width = 12, height = 9)

# ---
# 4. Plot 2 (Hit Rate) by Familiarity
# ---
print("Generating Plot 2 (Hit Rate) by Familiarity...")

# 1. Calculate Stimuli Totals (Denominators) by familiarity
stimuli_totals_fam <- df_analysis_with_familiarity %>%
  group_by(exposure_spanish_accent, condition.x) %>%
  count(name = "Total_Stimuli")

# 2. Calculate Detections (Numerators) by familiarity
detections_fam <- df_analysis_with_familiarity %>%
  filter(err_reported_clean == "y") %>%
  mutate(
    Phon_Detected = err_type_response %in% c("p", "both"),
    NonPhon_Detected = err_type_response %in% c("np", "both")
  ) %>%
  group_by(exposure_spanish_accent, condition.x) %>%
  summarise(
    Phon_Detections = sum(Phon_Detected),
    NonPhon_Detections = sum(NonPhon_Detected),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. Join and Calculate Proportions
plot_data_summary_fam <- stimuli_totals_fam %>%
  left_join(detections_fam, by = c("exposure_spanish_accent", "condition.x")) %>%
  mutate(
    `phonological error` = Phon_Detections / Total_Stimuli,
    `nonphonological error` = NonPhon_Detections / Total_Stimuli
  ) %>%
  filter(condition.x != "correct") %>%
  select(Stimulus_Condition = condition.x, exposure_spanish_accent, `phonological error`, `nonphonological error`) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`phonological error`, `nonphonological error`),
    names_to = "Error_Type_Detected",
    values_to = "Proportion"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Proportion)) %>% 
# --- THIS IS THE NEW LINE ---
  # Re-order the x-axis from left to right
  mutate(Stimulus_Condition = factor(Stimulus_Condition, 
                                     levels = c("phon_err", "non_phon_err", "both_err")))
  # --- END NEW LINE ---


# 4. Create the plot with facet_wrap()
p_hit_rate_chart_familiarity <- ggplot(plot_data_summary_fam, 
                           aes(x = Stimulus_Condition, y = Proportion, fill = Error_Type_Detected)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  
  # --- THIS IS THE NEW LINE ---
  facet_wrap(~ exposure_spanish_accent) +
  # --- END NEW LINE ---
  
  labs(
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Proportion of Errors Detected",
    fill = "Error Type Detected"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"), 
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_hit_rate_chart_familiarity)
ggsave("hit_rate_by_stimulus_by_familiarity.png", width = 12, height = 9)
print("--- Analysis by familiarity complete. ---")
```
